source.name: Avianas Feather
source.description: All damage dealt by carriers is considered as Magical damage.

descriptions.en: All damage dealt by carriers is considered as Magical damage.
descriptions.ru: Весь урон нанесенный владельцем считается Магическим.
descriptions.zh-cn: 携带者造成的所有伤害都视为魔法伤害。
descriptions.zh-tw: 攜帶者造成的所有傷害都視爲魔法傷害。
